provenance.notes: Scales and labels come from the official ARR review form page; the reviewer checklist from the reviewer guidelines. The four text field names (Paper Summary, Summary of Strengths, Summary of Weaknesses, Comments/Suggestions/Typos) come from an older ARR cycle described in a research paper and were not on the pages above: check them against the live form.

notes: The ARR reviewer guidelines say the reviewer must write the content and argument of the review personally and that using generative assistance to create the first draft is not permitted (light paraphrasing help is allowed). LLM-written content is therefore hidden in this export.

The guidelines also say not to upload a manuscript to non-privacy-preserving generative tools and not to submit confidential information to third-party services. The online checks send the title, one abstract sentence and reference titles to Crossref, Semantic Scholar, arXiv and OpenAlex: turn them off for ARR papers.

sections.label: Paper Summary
sections.guidance: Describe what the paper is about, to help action editors understand the topic and spot misunderstandings.

sections.label: Summary of Strengths
sections.guidance: Major reasons to publish at a selective *ACL venue, for example novel and useful methodology, insightful results or analysis, clear related literature.

sections.label: Soundness

labels.5: Excellent: one of the most thorough studies of its type
labels.4: Strong: sufficient support for all claims
labels.3: Acceptable: sufficient support for main claims; minor points may need more
labels.2: Poor: some main claims insufficiently supported; major problems
labels.1: Major Issues: not thorough enough, or not relevant to ACL

sections.guidance: Must be justified by the review text. Left for the human reviewer.

sections.label: Excitement
sections.guidance: Personal taste, separate from soundness. Left for the human reviewer.

sections.label: Reproducibility

labels.2: Would be hard pressed to reproduce

sections.guidance: Justify low scores. The tool lists keyword-based reproducibility gaps below as hints.

labels.5: Positive, read carefully, familiar with related work
labels.3: Pretty sure, did not check details such as math or experimental design
labels.2: Willing to defend, may have missed details

sections.label: Limitations and Societal Impact
sections.guidance: Do the authors adequately discuss limitations and positive and negative societal impact? Suggest improvements if not.

sections.label: Ethical Concerns
sections.guidance: Check the ACL Code of Ethics and the authors' ARR checklist; describe issues and how the authors addressed them.

sections.label: Needs Ethics Review
sections.guidance: Should the paper go to a separate in-depth ethics review? Explain if yes.

checklist.text: The paper is appropriate for the venue (topic, type).
No problems with the Responsible NLP checklist.
